ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a CD555/555 timer circuit, with pin 8 and pin 4 connected to +Vcc, pin 1 grounded, pin 3 as the output uo, and pin 5 grounded through a 0.01 μF capacitor. On the left side, R1 is connected from +Vcc to the node where pin 7 is located, and R2 is connected from that node to the upper end of the timing capacitor C; the upper end of capacitor C is also connected to pin 2 and pin 6, and the lower end of the capacitor is grounded. Reasoning: This connection method is the standard astable multivibrator of the 555. When capacitor C charges, it charges through R1 and R2, so the charging time is approximately t_charge = 0.693(R1 + R2)C; when the capacitor discharges, it discharges through R2 and the internal discharge transistor of pin 7, so the discharging time is approximately t_discharge = 0.693R2C. The output period is the sum of the two: T = 0.693(R1 + R2)C + 0.693R2C = 0.693(R1 + 2R2)C, usually approximately written as T = 0.7(R1 + 2R2)C.

raw_record.question_text: For the CD555 timer circuit shown in the figure, what is the period \(T\) of the output pulse in terms of \(R_1\), \(R_2\), and \(C\)?

method.method_draft: First identify from the image that the CD555 is wired as the standard astable multivibrator. The timing capacitor C is connected to the joined trigger/threshold pins 2 and 6, while the discharge pin 7 sits between R1 and R2. During charging, C charges through R1 and R2, giving t_charge ≈ 0.693(R1+R2)C. During discharging, C discharges through R2 via pin 7, giving t_discharge ≈ 0.693R2C. Therefore the output period is T = t_charge + t_discharge = 0.693(R1+2R2)C ≈ 0.7(R1+2R2)C.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个 CD555/555 定时器电路，8 脚和 4 脚接到 +Vcc，1 脚接地，3 脚为输出 uo，5 脚通过 0.01 μF 电容接地。左侧 R1 从 +Vcc 接到 7 脚所在节点，R2 从该节点接到定时电容 C 的上端；电容 C 的上端同时接到 2 脚和 6 脚，电容下端接地。推理：这种连接方式是 555 的标准无稳态多谐振荡器。电容 C 充电时经 R1 和 R2 充电，所以充电时间约为 t_charge = 0.693(R1 + R2)C；电容放电时通过 R2 和 7 脚内部放电管放电，所以放电时间约为 t_discharge = 0.693R2C。输出周期为两者之和：T = 0.693(R1 + R2)C + 0.693R2C = 0.693(R1 + 2R2)C，通常近似写为 T = 0.7(R1 + 2R2)C。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer gives exactly the same period formula as the standard answer: T = 0.7(R1 + 2R2)C.
